plugins.description: Operational workflows: KYC document parsing and rules-grid evaluation

skills.name: kyc-doc-parse
skills.description: Parse an investor or client onboarding packet into structured KYC fields — identity, ownership, control, source of funds, and document inventory. Use as the first step of KYC screening; output feeds the rules engine.
skills.description_zh: 将投资者或客户开户材料解析为结构化 KYC 字段，包括身份、所有权、控制关系、资金来源及文件清单，作为后续规则筛查的输入。

skills.name: kyc-rules
skills.description: Apply the firm's KYC/AML rules grid to a parsed onboarding record — assign a risk rating, list every rule outcome with the rule cited, and flag what's missing or escalation-worthy. Use after kyc-doc-parse; this skill decides nothing, it scores and routes.
skills.description_zh: 对已解析的开户记录应用机构 KYC/AML 规则矩阵，列出带规则依据的结果、风险等级、缺失项和升级事项；负责评分与分流，不作最终决定。
